title: Access Controller Registration
description: Published by Access Controller to telemetry/{tenant_id}/{controller_id}/registration on startup

capabilities.description: What this controller advertises. The Go edge sends heartbeat, registration, events, read, write, test_connection; the Java edge sends shell, test_connection, healthcheck, introspect, read, write, ddl, mcp; jdbc and http are the original route types. Core stores the list as given and gates nothing on it.

templates.description: adr-060 — the certified route templates compiled into this edge, which run_template can run. Core refuses to save a Connection whose adapter needs a template the edge does not advertise (template_not_certified). OPTIONAL; an edge that omits it advertises none.

runtime.description: Phase 14.9 — Edge process topology, auto-detected at startup; informs mount-time host validation. OPTIONAL field; absence is treated as 'unknown' by metafore-core. Edge clients prior to 1.1.0 omit this field. 'kubernetes' is what the platform's own chart and edge manifest set (EDGE_RUNTIME).

runtime_hints.description: Phase 14.9 — Free-form diagnostic context backing the runtime classification (os_name, java_version, hostname, docker_env_file_present, cgroup_signature). OPTIONAL; for operator diagnostics only — not consumed by any deterministic logic.
